name: argon_piston_compression
title: Argon compression in a piston-cylinder: adiabatic, isothermal, polytropic
summary: Closed-system compression of 0.2 kg of argon from 100 kPa and 300 K to 600 kPa in a piston-cylinder: boundary work and first-law heat of the reversible adiabatic (isentropic), isothermal and polytropic (n = 1.3) paths, with T-s points.

authors: TBD (ULiège THD10 course solution; no author named in the file)
origin.course: Thermodynamique appliquée (ULiège, THD10), session R05, exercise 1 (2010)

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution (compare_solution.py, rtol=0.001, --ees-units): max rel. diff 5.56e-03 on four display temperatures (0.15 K: the original used -273, the library -273.15); excluding them, max 4.21e-03 on W_s, from the argon cp difference EES 8.4 vs CoolProp (gamma 1.6667 vs 1.6695). Isothermal and polytropic works agree to 6e-09.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of THD10_R05_E1.EES (EES 8.423), 42 variables, 38 common with the model
verification.notes: 13 of 38 common variables differ at rtol=0.001: 4 display temperatures (273 vs 273.15 conversion), the rest cascading from the cp difference of argon between EES ideal-gas and CoolProp real-fluid data. Q_s = 0 and Q_t = -W_t recovered exactly (energy-balance check). Stale EES variables w, T_1, p[1], p[2] not defined by the file's equations.
